definitions.description: The school category identifies the broad magical discipline a spell belongs to.
Protective magic that blocks, shields, wards, dispels, or banishes harmful forces.
Magic that summons, creates, transports, or relocates creatures, objects, and substances.
Magic that reveals hidden information, detects unseen things, or predicts possible futures.
Magic that alters thoughts, emotions, behavior, choices, or mental states.
Magic that directly produces, shapes, or releases energy and elemental power.
Magic that deceives the senses or creates false images, sounds, sensations, and appearances.
Magic that manipulates life force, death, undeath, decay, and the boundary between living and dead.
Magic that changes the physical, material, biological, or magical properties of an existing target.
The essence category identifies the substance, energy, element, living principle, or metaphysical domain expressed by a spell.
Fire represents flames, heat, ignition, combustion, and burning energy.
Cold represents frost, ice, snow, freezing, and the removal of heat.
Lightning represents explicitly electrical phenomena: electric current, charged particles, sparks, arcs, electrocution, and natural lightning.
Thunder represents explicitly sonic or concussive phenomena: thunder damage, pressure waves, violent vibration, deafening resonance, and shockwaves.
Acid represents corrosion, dissolution, chemical erosion, and caustic substances.
Poison represents toxins, venom, contamination, disease, and biological corruption.
Force represents explicitly non-elemental magical force: telekinetic pressure, invisible impact, force fields, and effects identified as Force damage.
Radiance represents explicitly sacred, celestial, or radiant energy, especially Radiant damage, holy power, purification, and sunlight-like divine brilliance.
Necrosis represents decay, entropy, corruption, withering, undeath, and necrotic energy.
Life represents direct manipulation of vitality: healing wounds, restoring Hit Points, sustaining living bodies, regeneration, and biological growth.
not_associated: Hit Points used only as object durability

definitions.description: Mind represents direct interaction with cognition, perception, memory, emotion, telepathy, dreams, intelligence, and psychic harm.
Soul represents explicit spirits, ghosts, souls, astral selves, possession, resurrection identity, and existence beyond the physical body.

Time represents explicit temporal manipulation: haste, slowing, stopping time, aging, rewinding, delaying, repeating, or altering temporal sequence, including personal time dilation that speeds up or slows down how quickly a creature acts, moves, and takes turns, such as doubling or halving a creature's speed and granting or removing an action on its turn.
associated: gains an additional action on each of its turns
can take only one action or bonus action, not both

definitions.description: Space represents explicit spatial manipulation: teleportation, portals, planar displacement, extradimensional spaces, and changes to distance or location without ordinary travel.
Air represents wind, atmosphere, gases, pressure, breath, and weather carried through the sky.
Earth represents soil, terrain, clay, sand, ground, and the natural land.
Water represents liquids, rivers, rain, oceans, tides, waves, and fluid motion.
Plant represents vegetation, roots, vines, leaves, forests, seeds, and botanical life.
Stone represents rock, crystal, masonry, mineral structures, and solid geological material.
Metal represents metallic substances, alloys, forged objects, weapons, armor, and conductive structures.
not_associated: ordinary weapons with no metal manipulation

definitions.description: Light represents explicit visible illumination and optical brightness: emitted light, flashes, beams, glowing radiance, and changes to visibility.
Shadow represents explicit magical darkness, dimming, concealment through darkness, shadow material, or umbral energy.
Sound represents explicit acoustic phenomena: audible speech, music, tones, echoes, hearing, silence, and sound-based communication or effects.
Magic represents raw or self-referential magical substance: antimagic, dispelling, spell energy, magical fields, glyphs, and effects whose essence is magic itself rather than an element.
not_associated: magical only as a generic adjective
doubling or halving a creature's speed
gaining or losing an action on a turn

definitions.description: The intent category identifies the primary outcome a spell is designed to produce, independent of its element or spatial shape.
Burst represents directly inflicting immediate harm through damage, destructive energy, or a harmful attack whose primary result is injury.
Protection represents preventing or reducing harm, improving defenses, granting resistance or cover, blocking access, suppressing threats, or preserving a target's safety.
not_associated: heal damage after it occurs without defensive benefit

definitions.description: Creation represents causing a new creature, object, structure, substance, duplicate, construct, or persistent magical manifestation to exist.
Transformation represents materially or biologically changing an existing target's form, body, properties, senses, size, condition, or capabilities.
Movement represents deliberately relocating a creature or object, granting or changing travel modes, increasing mobility, teleporting, pushing, pulling, or controlling spatial motion.
not_associated: animation without relocation as the primary purpose
ordinary target movement in rules text

definitions.description: Knowledge represents obtaining or transmitting information: detecting, identifying, perceiving, predicting, understanding, revealing, observing, or communicating knowledge.
not_associated: knowledge mentioned only in spell name without information gain

definitions.description: Influence represents changing another creature's behavior, choices, emotions, agency, attitude, actions, or mental state without primarily changing its physical form.
not_associated: saving throw penalty without behavioral effect
command an animated servant already under control

definitions.description: The flow category identifies the geometric or sequential pattern through which a spell's effect propagates.
Point affects one specific target, object, location, or origin without visible propagation.
Projectile travels from an origin toward a target before producing its main effect.
Line propagates along a straight, narrow path from an origin.
Cone expands outward from an origin in a widening directional area.
Burst expands outward from a central point and affects an area around it.
Wall forms a continuous barrier, boundary, surface, curtain, or partition.
Aura continuously surrounds and radiates from a creature, object, or fixed source.
Chain propagates sequentially from one target to another nearby target.
The reach category identifies the practical distance over which a spell can affect a target or location.
Touch requires direct physical contact with the target.
Close affects targets within a short nearby distance from the caster.
Medium affects targets at a moderate tactical distance.
Far affects distant targets well beyond ordinary close combat range.
Unlimited has effectively unrestricted, planetary, planar, or otherwise exceptional range.
The ornamentation category identifies decorative visual motifs added to a sigil without changing the spell's core meaning.
Runes are angular written symbols used as mystical letters, labels, borders, or repeated magical marks.
Geometric ornamentation uses simple shapes such as circles, triangles, squares, diamonds, lines, and polygons.
